load_samples: load all numpy sample files from the ava_samples directory and return them as a list
load_batches: load sample batches with configurable batch size, views, and resolution for overfitting
visualize_sample: visualize a single dataset sample as an MP4 video with video, keypoints, and reference image
review_load_batches: review the load_batches function to understand how it preprocesses and collates samples
refactor_visualize_sample: refactor the visualize_sample function to support additional tensor reshaping and video output options
